faqPage.title: Everything you need to know about Harmony
faqPage.subtitle: Answers about the product, the AI helpers, your data, and getting access. Can't find it here? Join the waitlist and ask us directly.

items.a: Harmony is an autonomous operating system for your life and business. It unifies your tasks, calendar, documents, teams, and operations in one place, then puts AI helpers to work planning and completing the routine — with you approving what matters.

items.q: How is Harmony different from other AI tools?
items.a: Most AI tools assist: they draft, summarize, or answer. Harmony executes — it coordinates a team of specialized helpers to take real work all the way to done, across both your personal and business hubs.
Founders, entrepreneurs, professionals, families, small businesses, and growing companies — anyone who runs a lot and wants leverage without adding more tools or overhead.

items.q: Do I need to be technical to use it?
items.a: No. Harmony is designed for Apple-level simplicity. You describe what you want in plain language and approve the work; Harmony handles the mechanics.

The Personal Hub runs your life (tasks, goals, notes, calendar, assistant). The Business Hub runs your company (teams, operations, communications, documents, approvals, AI departments). The Harmony Hub is the intelligence layer that coordinates both.

items.q: Can I use only the Personal Hub or only the Business Hub?
items.a: Yes. Start with whichever fits your needs today and add the other when you are ready — the Harmony Hub coordinates whatever you turn on.

items.q: What is the Founder Command Center?
items.a: A single screen to steer the whole operation: see what your AI helpers are doing, approve high-impact actions, and watch the metrics that move your life and business.
No. Harmony amplifies your team by removing busywork and running the routine, so people stay focused on judgment, relationships, and decisions that need a human.

items.q: What can the AI helpers actually do?
items.a: They plan your day, triage and draft communications, prepare and run workflows, track operations, and complete approved tasks end to end — coordinated by an AI Chief of Staff.
Always. Harmony works through approvals, guardrails, and a complete audit trail. You decide how much autonomy to grant and can change it at any time.

items.q: How does autonomy increase over time?
items.a: Harmony moves through levels you control — monitor, recommend, prepare, then execute low-risk work — earning more autonomy only as you build trust, never less oversight.
You do. Data ownership is a core principle of Harmony, and you can export or remove your data.
Harmony is built around privacy and security, with transparency into exactly what each helper can see and do.

items.q: Can I see what the AI helpers did?
items.a: Yes. Every meaningful action is logged in a reviewable audit trail, so nothing happens as a black box.
Join the waitlist. We are onboarding founders and early teams in waves and will send your invite when your spot is ready.
Priority onboarding, a direct line to the team, influence over the roadmap, and founding-member pricing locked in.
Pricing will be shared with early-access invites. Founding members lock in founding-member pricing.

categories.title: Getting started

articles.title: Create your account
articles.body: Sign up with your email, confirm your address, and choose whether to start with your Personal Hub, Business Hub, or both.

articles.body: Pick a hub to begin, answer a few quick prompts, and Harmony tailors your workspace and first suggestions to you.

articles.body: Use the Harmony Hub as your home base — it surfaces what needs attention and links you straight to the right place.

categories.description: Run your life: tasks, goals, notes, calendar, and your assistant.

articles.title: Manage tasks and goals
articles.body: Capture tasks in plain language; Harmony prioritizes them and breaks goals into milestones it tracks for you.

articles.body: Link your calendar so Harmony can schedule, protect focus time, and resolve conflicts automatically.

articles.title: Work with your AI assistant
articles.body: Ask your assistant to draft, book, remind, and handle small tasks — then approve its work in one tap.

categories.title: Business Hub
categories.description: Run your company: teams, operations, communications, and approvals.

articles.title: Set up Operations
articles.body: Define how your work runs once, and Harmony keeps it on track without the chasing.

articles.title: AI Departments overview
articles.body: Turn on specialized AI departments — marketing, support, finance and more — that coordinate through the Harmony Hub.

articles.title: Approvals and autonomy

categories.title: Harmony Hub
categories.description: Your AI Chief of Staff coordinating everything end to end.

articles.title: Meet your AI Chief of Staff
articles.body: The Harmony Hub understands your priorities and drives them forward across your personal and business hubs.

articles.title: Cross-hub coordination
articles.body: Harmony connects life and business so a personal constraint never collides with a work commitment.

articles.title: Review the audit trail
